properties.description:
The user likes symbol navigation as a starting point but wants it expanded. They report being unable to return to the location they came from after navigating to a symbol. Record the return-navigation problem without selecting a navigation-history or UI design yet.

Feedback (verbatim):
"I like as a starting point to be able to navigate toward symbol navigation but we clearly to expend the feature, among things that feel bad is that you can't o back from where you came. Don't know yet how i want to solve that though so create an input with the feedback."
properties.title: Return navigation after going to a symbol
